rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for physically constructing a building or object.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 hei2 ni1 gaan1 uk1

rows.note: Use this for developing or establishing an organization, system, or other planned structure.

example.english: We need to build a sound system step by step.
example.traditional: 我哋要逐步建立一套完善嘅制度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zuk6 bou6 gin3 laap6 jat1 tou3 jyun4 sin6 ge3 zai3 dou6

rows.note: Use this when tension, conflict, or a relationship gradually becomes more intense.

example.english: The tension slowly began to build as the two sides argued online.
example.traditional: 雙方喺網上鬧交，氣氛慢慢升溫。
example.jyutping: soeng1 fong1 hai2 mong5 soeng6 naau6 gaau1 hei3 fan1 maan6 maan6 sing1 wan1

rows.note: Use this when something is built up gradually by accumulating more of it over time.

example.english: You need to build experience gradually, so don't rush.
example.traditional: 你要慢慢累積經驗，唔好心急。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 maan6 maan6 leoi4 zik1 ging1 jim6 m4 hou2 sam1 gap1
